title: NASA flight surgeon on Apollo astronauts shunning Edgar Mitchell
summary: John Blitch tells of NASA flight surgeon on Apollo astronauts shunning Edgar Mitchell, about summer 2008 at Aquarius underwater base off Key Largo, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Aquarius underwater base off Key Largo

tellings.quote:
I was

NASA flight surgeon Who Remain unnamed

plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, says that in the summer of 2008 he was diving at Aquarius, an underwater research base off Key Largo in Florida, with a NASA flight surgeon, a doctor who looks after astronauts, whom he won't name. According to Blitch, the doctor told him that the Apollo astronauts, the men from the moon missions, shunned their fellow astronaut Edgar Mitchell. He tells it because it suggests that speaking openly about strange experiences can cost even an astronaut his standing.
